_comment: Guided puzzle solutions for FINAL FANTASY III (src/core/field/puzzle_guide.cpp). Map ids are the map master's (tools/mapdump/ff3_master/map.txt); cells are baked tile coordinates, one row above the dumps' ty for tile objects since the 2026-10-11 bottom-edge fix in bake_maps.py (tools/mapdump/ff3_objects.jsonl). Authored 2026-10-10 from the dumps' developer labels (hidden-door switches); not yet tested in game.
